person_made_it: Foster's world: his brand book type and palette, his poster's frog sage painted into 4 chambers and 12 lessons by Higgsfield, his own FANGSPEARE ViSUALS loops and Tsathoggua mask in the stage kit; sound by ElevenLabs; dot wrote the teaching.
emcee_who_is_speaking: A stock ElevenLabs library voice (Brad, not a clone, not any artist) coaches every one of the 12 lessons; every line transcribed back verbatim.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Night at the mound, then deeper and darker: the stair, the city of Tsath, the deepest hall.
did_the_click_pay_me: Yes: every stone ignites into a living diagram of its lesson on a 140 BPM clock, lights green when done, and the ambient bed and descent sounds play once sound is on.
works_for_the_recipient: Machine checks pass in Chromium 1440 and WebKit 390 with real clicks (videos play, sheets open and close, stones light, notes add, no overflow, 0 errors); not yet heard or seen on Foster's own phone.
taught_me_something: Yes: dot's 12 sessions, each with its drill, pass mark, self-rated rubric and a diagram that shows the idea (beat one, bass handoff, phrase exits, energy arc, 60 Hz sigil).
told_me_the_truth: Yes: notes are session only until exported and say so; the study sets open on YouTube; the cymatics mode is labeled simulated; audio was machine-checked, not heard.
weakest: Coach lines and chamber sounds are machine-checked only; nobody has listened on a real phone yet, so a heard pass is next.
